summary: The four R1 scorer counterexamples are fixed and all full registered CPU fixture paths score successfully. Frozen dev-source completeness and exact shard sequence binding still fail.
scope: Exact R2 85757 plan / 44 source files in private isolated clone. All executed predictions, timings and native metadata are artificial CPU protocol fixtures, never benchmark results. Current live R3 edits are excluded.

issues.title: Frozen selection still lacks complete dev-run provenance
issues.details: The shared frozen-selection guard checks only that an arbitrary artifact map is nonempty and that its listed hashes match. It does not establish complete required raw files, their run identity/coverage, or that the report scores were computed from those files.
issues.own_executed_counterexample: After valid full-dev scoring and freezing, removing one prediction hash from every report and updating the receipt hashes was still admitted.
issues.independently_read_peer_counterexample: The separate NN-source reviewer executed exact R2 freezer main with three declared full-dev reports that bind only UNRELATED_MARKER.txt. It wrote FROZEN and the selection guard admitted it despite no runs directory, predictions, GT, timing, config, COMPLETE or native records.
issues.required_fix: Validate exact full raw run coverage and identity; recompute the full three-cost dev reports from those bound raw files and compare their values before writing an immutable selection.

issues.title: Configured shard id is not bound to its actual sequence assignment
issues.details: The complete two-shard fixture was accepted after swapping shard ids and matching canonical commands, while retaining each old sequence list/files. Aggregate sequence coverage stayed complete, so the numerical full-dataset score was unchanged, but the purported executed shard/config identity contradicts the runner slicing rule.
issues.required_fix: Require each config.sequences to exactly equal the registered manifest sequence list sliced as [shard::shards].

gt_provenance.evidence: Reused exact R1 GT comparison after all933 toolkit/GT byte hashes and five full manifest hashes rechecked.

metric_arithmetic.evidence: Unchanged toolkit, unchanged old LasHeR scorer, unchanged groundtruth/load_manifest functions. Seven independent R1 goldens reused, not rerun.

canonical_command_and_consistency.details: The four R1 counterexamples, nine mismatched argv fields, invalid GPU/path/partial shard/grid/candidate cases and altered selection SHA/bytes are rejected; shard-to-sequence assignment remains R2-M2.

benchmark_result_claims.details: No benchmark performance, actual NN native completion, actual model capacity or trained-checkpoint claim is supported by synthetic protocol fixtures.
